title: Society & politics
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. One of the four new B2 strands, anchored to news and crime. THE RISK HERE WAS NOT THE OLD UNITS BUT THE NEW ONE: leaf_news_b2, drafted this morning on this same lane, already took referendum, coalition, opposition, majority, minority, policy, legislation, corruption, transparency, accountability, inequality, welfare, refugee, unrest, riot, demonstration, activist and boycott. The shipped pool cannot see any of it, because that node is still `coming`. The corrected sweep returned inequality, welfare and refugee as already taught and all three were dropped; the political-process words were excluded by hand for the same reason. So this unit deliberately does not do parties, elections or protest at all. Its three angles are who belongs (citizen, citizenship, immigration, migrant, integration, multicultural, stereotype, prejudice, discrimination, tolerance), fair and unfair (equality, gender, racism, privilege, homelessness, social class, social mobility, solidarity, volunteer, feminism), and how a country is actually run (democracy, dictatorship, constitution, authority, bureaucracy, taxpayer, public sector, infrastructure, mayor, rural, civil rights). B2-PLAN's own instruction for this node is `watch register — trim anything that smells C1`, so hegemony, marginalisation, disenfranchisement and the rest of that layer were left out on purpose; every word here is one a B2 student meets in a newspaper. No C57 card — new strand, no predecessor — so card 0 names what it builds on instead. Build-the-family: citizen -> citizenship, discriminate -> discrimination, homeless -> homelessness, democracy -> democratic. E10 Use is rewrite production; every underline reconstructs its answer.

cards.title: What you already have
cards.note: This is a new strand. News 1 and 2 gave you the political process — government, election, vote, politician, law, minister, protest — and Crime 1 and 2 gave you the courts. This unit does not repeat either. It asks the questions underneath them: who counts as belonging here, what is fair and what is not, and who actually runs the place.
cards.note_cz: Tohle je nová větev. News 1 a 2 ti daly politický proces — government, election, vote, politician, law, minister, protest — a Crime 1 a 2 daly soudy. Tahle lekce ani jedno neopakuje. Ptá se na to, co je pod tím: kdo sem patří, co je spravedlivé a co ne, a kdo to tu vlastně řídí.

cards.title: Build the family
points: Four pairs, each a person or an act and the state that goes with it.
